styles.name: icosahedron

styles.name: cuboctahedron

styles.name: nested-solids

styles.name: stellated-dodecahedron
styles.description: Great stellated dodecahedron: dodecahedron with 12 pentagonal star-pyramids erupting from each face — a cosmic sea-urchin

styles.name: unfolding-net
styles.description: Cube net: a cross-shaped flat net folds progressively into a 3-D cube as progress advances — geometry becoming solid
